title: Complement of passing
statement:
A machined part passes inspection with probability [$p]. What is the probability that it **fails** inspection?

[______]{a}
hints: Pass and fail together cover every outcome, so their probabilities add to 1.
solution: Fail is the complement of pass, so $P(\text{fail}) = 1 - P(\text{pass}) = 1 - [$p]$.
